title: Got the lipsync working for my point and click game engine
author: Ok-Suspect-9855
selftext: Finally got the lipsync working for my 2d point and click game engine the voice and sync just below realtime. The next step is to setup the local ai in the browser and the speech to text so players can have proper conversation with all the npcs.

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body: no thats just to test. There will be no script in the final games each character has their own ai model in the browser so they can speak dynamically.

comments.author: vincestrom
comments.body: Can I ask what you are using? I've also tried a few things in that area, but lipsync AI models can't really work with low enough latency on usual consumer hardware. I've also used phoneme mapping on 2d images, but it isnt as smooth as I'd like.

replies.author: Ok-Suspect-9855
replies.body: yeah, so I'm using wave to lip. But it's a modified version. I will say with a lot of work with weeks of trial and error, that's why I was celebrating doing it. A couple of things wav2lip is not meant for images, it's meant for videos. So potntially that's why it didn't look that good when you were looking at it. What I do is I make a speaking video and I encode the positions for each for the face for each frame in advance. So the latency you're seeing there, the one second or two second is the TTS. The actual, I think it's thirty milliseconds for the wave to lip. And it's I think five megabytes or something, five or ten megabytes. It'll run on a potato. So I'm doing the AI models, the TTS. The STT And the lip sync. And they all need to be real time, or close enough to real time, so it's really a game of milliseconds. Everything has to be you just Keep modifying little pieces. Until you get a millisecond, a few mill milliseconds here, a few milliseconds there, it's There's not a lot of Things that you can do that will give you everything together that fast. Currently got the the local ai model at 100ms, STT at 150ms, the TTS at 1s and the lipsync at 30ms all on cpu using wep gpu or wasm. I'm working on getting the TTS down now especially for longer sentences. To do all of this this, I've invented a few new technologies and heavily modified the existing off-the-shelf technologies.

replies.author: vincestrom
replies.body: Thanks a lot for the thorough explanation ! Pretty interesting, gives me new ideas to explore.
